answer_2.quote: We use a RoBERTa‑Large classifier trained on the Corpus of Linguistic Acceptability (COLA) to make judgement on the grammatical acceptability of the poisoned instances for each method.

answer_4.quote: We ask five human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to classify them into human‑written instances and machine‑edited instances. For human evaluation, we sample 30 poisoned test instances ... We ask three annotators on AMT to rate on a scale of 1‑3 ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate semantic similarity on a 1‑3 scale, judge label consistency, assess naturalness, and identify suspicious (machine‑edited) instances.
